The '''RSF Sword''' was a [[Limb/Legends|single-handed]], bladed [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] commonly used by [[Fencing|fencers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As indicated by its name, the [[Sword/Legends|sword]] was affiliated with the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], otherwise known as the RSF. Despite being decorated with [[Imperial crest/Legends|insignias]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the weapon was actually most often carried by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] named [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[OR-5]] also possessed a variation of the weapon known as "[[OR-5's Sword]]."

==Description==
RSF [[Sword/Legends|Swords]] were [[Limb/Legends|single-handed]], bladed [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]]. The weapon was composed of units of [[Steel/Legends|steel]] and [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]]. The sword also comprised of a melee weapon core. The sword was decorated with [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Imperial crest/Legends|insignias]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the pommel and cross guard.<ref name="AED" />

==History==
The weapon saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Galactic Empire and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Commonly used by [[Fencing|fencers]], the weapon was affiliated with the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], otherwise known as the RSF. Despite being decorated with [[Imperial crest/Legends|insignias]] of the Galactic Empire,<ref name="AED" /> the weapon was actually most often carried by members of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Melee" /> Schematics of the weapon were also available to independent [[weaponsmith]]s and [[Merchant/Legends|munitions traders]].<ref name="AED" /> A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] named [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[OR-5]] possessed a variation of the weapon known as "[[OR-5's Sword]]," while occupying a decrepit [[Neimoidian droid factory|Droid Factory]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="TOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
A group of adventuring [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], attempting to shut down the Droid Factory, battled OR-5 and destroyed [[Gender/Legends|him]]. OR-5's Sword fell into the possession of one member of the group.<ref name="TOW" /> OR-5 possessed at least one other sword that was left behind and abandoned in a corner of the [[Stronghold Cantina|cantina]] in [[Nym's Stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok]]. The weapon was eventually discovered and collected by a spacer passing through the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:OR5SwordLok.jpg|130px|thumb|One of OR-5's Swords in the cantina of Nym's Stronghold on Lok]]
The [[W:c:swg:RSF Sword|RSF Sword]] was included as a [[W:c:swg:One-Handed Melee Weapon|one-handed]] [[W:c:swg:Melee weapon|melee weapon]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The [[W:c:swg:Weapon|weapon]] was added to the game at some point during the implementation of the [[W:c:swg:Combat Upgrade|Combat Upgrade]], which was introduced on [[April 27]], [[2005]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> After being included in the game, the weapon could be [[W:c:swg:Crafting|crafted]] by [[W:c:swg:Weaponsmith (pre NGE)|weaponsmiths]] for primary use by players of the [[W:c:swg:Fencer|fencer]] [[W:c:swg:Professions (pre-NGE)|profession]].<ref name="AED" />

Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], fencers and weaponsmiths were removed,<ref name="NGE" /> however the weapon could still be constructed by players of the newly created [[W:c:swg:Trader (Munitions)|munitions trader]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]]. The profession prerequisite for the weapon was also removed. The weapon could be constructed using a number of different [[W:c:swg:Ranged weapon component|components]] and [[W:c:swg:Resource|resources]], including [[W:c:swg:Steel|steel]] and [[W:c:swg:Polymer|polymer]]. Although it was typically considered a [[W:c:swg:Kinetic damage|kinetic-based]] weapon, some [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] versions of the sword were curiously characterized as [[W:c:swg:Energy damage|energy]] weapons.<ref name="AED" />

In the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Expansion|expansion pack]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]'', a variant of the RSF Sword could be looted from a non-player character named [[W:c:swg:Colonel OR-5|OR-5]] in the Decrepit Droid Factory during the course of the [[W:c:swg:Champions of Mustafar|''Champions of Mustafar'']] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]]. The weapon was named "OR-5's Sword."<ref name="TOW" /> With the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7: ''A Collection of Heroes'']] on [[November 1]], [[2007]], a [[W:c:swg:Collection system|collection system]] was added as a type of [[W:c:swg:Mini-game|mini-game]].<ref name="Collection">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref> One such collection, titled [[W:c:swg:Rare Melee Weapons Mark II|''Rare Melee Weapons Mark II'']], required players to discover and collect 16 different melee weapons scattered throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. OR-5's Sword was one of the weapons included as part of this collection, and it could be found by players in the [[W:c:swg:Cantina|cantina]] of [[W:c:swg:Nym's Stronghold|Nym's Stronghold]] on the [[W:c:swg:Planet|planet]] [[W:c:swg:Lok|Lok]].<ref name="AED" /> Although the player could choose not to complete the quests or collections associated with OR-5's Sword, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="AED" /><ref name="TOW" />
